studio.components.title: Model files

studio.quick.title: Quick Settings
studio.quick.openStudioFirst: Open Studio first to enable reset actions.
studio.quick.confirm: Reset Studio authoring controls to defaults (including prompts, model selection, Options, LoRAs, presets/wildcards and post-processing)? Media, libraries, projects, stars, job history, queued/running jobs and backend configuration are kept.
studio.quick.confirmProject: Reset this project’s editable Studio controls to defaults? The changed draft will autosave. Global Studio preferences, media, libraries, projects, stars, job history, queued/running jobs and backend configuration are kept.
studio.run.opt.outputNaming.hint: Relative to Output/raw; no extension. The saver adds extension and counter. Placeholders (example value, local time):
studio.run.opt.outputNaming.invalid: Invalid naming: use a relative path with letters A–Z, digits, _ - . and /, and only the listed variables. No empty/parent folders, trailing dots or device names; max 512 characters, 180 per segment.
studio.run.maskGrowHelp: Crop to the mask plus this context margin, process at the model resolution, then composite back. Larger margins give more context; 0 crops tightly.

studio.api.notReady: Generation has not been verified. API detection does not confirm models or an executable Director recipe.
studio.engine.title: A connection, not a commitment.

studio.backendHelp: Default local port: 7801. Your engine must already be running.
studio.director.title: Give the shot a direction.
studio.director.notice: Keep the idea before you make it. These controls save a local draft only; generation and MiniMax H3 workflow submission are not implemented.
studio.director.local: Drafts stay on this device. Nothing is sent to your engine.
studio.placeholder: A slow tracking shot through a copper-lit forest…
studio.draft.saved: Draft saved on this device. No workflow submitted.
studio.draft.saveError: Could not save: local storage is unavailable. Keep this page open to retain your draft.

studio.roadmap: This feature is on the studio roadmap. Nothing here submits a workflow or generates media.
studio.plannedNotice: For now, explore the workspace and inspect your Engine. Creative tools will arrive in separate, verifiable steps.
studio.complete: Inspection complete · {url}. This is a snapshot, not a live connection.

studio.jobs.consent: I authorize this exact diagnostic plan and its resource use.
studio.jobs.unknown: Unknown — refresh status; do not resubmit.
studio.jobs.originalEndpoint: The draft endpoint changed. This job is still tracked on its original endpoint.
studio.jobs.ambiguous: Submission outcome is unknown. Do not resubmit: a job may already be running. No job ID was received; native recovery is required.
studio.jobs.pendingFeatures: Safe job-scoped cancellation is not implemented. No global interrupt is sent.
studio.jobs.saveTitle: Save diagnostic PNG as a new file
studio.jobs.noSessionJob: No native job is stored in this app session.

studio.run.reference.dlAsk: No CLIP vision model installed. Download clip_vision_g (CLIP-ViT-bigG fp16, 3.7 GB) from Hugging Face into models/clip_vision?
studio.run.reference.unsupported: Reference pictures work with SDXL checkpoints (up to 4). This model uses its native picture path: image-to-image, or the References tab for video models.
studio.run.prompt.copyFailed: Copy failed; select the text and copy it manually.
studio.run.customSchedule.hint: Custom sigma schedule active (Options tab): steps and scheduler come from it.
studio.run.opt.sigmas.hint: Fixed noise schedule instead of a scheduler: comma-separated, descending, ending at 0. Steps = values − 1. Empty = model default or scheduler.
studio.run.opt.sigmas.invalid: Invalid: comma-separated numbers, strictly descending, last one 0 — ignored.
studio.run.seedCopyFailed: Copy failed; select the seed and copy it manually.

studio.run.stop.settled: Stop finished. Check the retained job states.
studio.run.stop.partial: Stop was partial. Some jobs may still be active or unknown.
studio.run.stop.failed: Stop could not be confirmed. Job states are retained.
studio.run.stop.unsupported: This desktop does not support Workbench Stop.
studio.run.empty: Pick media on the left or run a prompt. Finished images appear here.

studio.run.queueEmpty: Nothing generated yet in this session.

studio.run.pipe.noRecipe: No verified recipe for this pipeline yet.
studio.run.edit.title: Edit image
studio.run.post.hint: Second pass with the same model, prompts and seed: optional upscale model, resize to {width}×{height}, then resample at the refiner strength.
studio.run.post.runHint: Apply Refine / Upscale alone to the shown image.
studio.run.post.tiledHint: Samples the refine pass in {width}×{height} tiles with {overlap} px overlap blended every step — the model’s native size, so large outputs stay sharp and seamless.
studio.run.post.tiledMissing: The backend does not list DaSiWaTiledDiffusion; install the DaSiWa node pack.
studio.run.edit.needsMask: Paint the area to repaint on the image.
studio.run.edit.insertHint: Drop an image from the Media dock’s Input or Output folder onto the picture to insert it (up to 4).
studio.run.edit.layerHelp: Drag to move, corner to resize. Keys: arrows move, + / − resize, Delete removes.
studio.run.family.unknown: Unknown architecture — no recipe can load it.
studio.run.family.noEncoder: Needs a matching text encoder and VAE in the models folder.
studio.run.resolution.title: Resolution
studio.run.resolution.invalid: Use 64–8192 px, multiples of 8, at most 16 MP.
studio.run.resolution.waiting: Waiting for reference dimensions. Check that the preview loads.
studio.run.resolution.hint.off: Pass the original image to the model; canvas settings do not resize it.
studio.run.resolution.hint.auto: Only downscale references whose short edge exceeds 2048 px.
studio.run.resolution.hint.target: Stretch the reference to the selected canvas.
studio.run.resolution.hint.fit: Preserve aspect inside the canvas; output can be smaller.
studio.run.resolution.hint.crop: Fill the canvas and center-crop excess edges.
studio.run.resolution.hint.pad: Fit the whole reference and pad to the canvas.
studio.run.resolution.hint.long: Match the long side to the canvas, then center-crop the other side to the grid; output can be smaller.
studio.run.opt.unread: Attention backends and patches are read from the running backend.
studio.run.opt.attention.hint: Patched per job. Comfy Kitchen is quantized INT8 attention, listed only where it runs (NVIDIA/AMD).
studio.run.opt.attention.noSage: Sage modes need ComfyUI-KJNodes and the sageattention package.
studio.run.opt.vae.hint: Tiled works in chunks to save VRAM at large sizes; full decoding already retries tiled after out-of-memory.
studio.run.opt.vae.both: The input image is encoded and the result decoded in tiles.
studio.run.opt.cache.hint: Skips similar sampling steps: faster, changes details. Start at 0.05; high thresholds can ruin the image.
studio.run.opt.cache.EasyCache: Reuses steps once the output settles; a higher threshold is faster and rougher.
studio.run.opt.cache.LazyCache: Simpler variant that works with every model; usually weaker than EasyCache.
studio.run.opt.missing.core: Not listed by this backend; update ComfyUI.
studio.run.opt.compile.hint: Compiles the model: the first run takes much longer, later runs can be faster. Needs Triton.
studio.run.opt.attention.sage: Needs the sageattention Python package in the backend; without it the job fails.
studio.run.opt.compile.kitchen: Not combinable with Comfy Kitchen attention.

studio.editor.wandHelp: Click adds the connected area of similar colour to the selected mask; Alt+click removes it. Higher tolerance grows the area.
studio.editor.canvasError: The mask canvas is unavailable. Reopen this image.
studio.editor.emptyMask: Paint a visible mask before running.
studio.editor.sourceSize: Resample this image to the selected model’s resolution grid before inpainting.
studio.editor.insertFailed: This image could not be loaded for insertion.
studio.run.metadata.workflowHelp: Loads the embedded workflow in the editor without running it.
studio.run.metadata.workflowBackend: Start the owned ComfyUI backend to open this workflow.
studio.run.metadata.workflowFailed: Could not open the workflow. Return to Studio and try again.
studio.run.video.lastFrameHint: Optional: mark an image as the last frame with its ⟶ Last frame button.
studio.run.pipe.needsVideo: Pick a video from the Media dock as the source.
studio.run.pipe.needsRefs: Add at least one reference with its “Add as reference” button.
studio.run.video.refsHint: Select images in the Media dock and press “Add as reference”; each guides the video from its second on.
studio.run.video.refsHintH3: Select images, videos or audio in the Media dock and press “Add as reference” (up to 9 images, 3 videos, 3 audio clips; clips 2–15 s).
studio.run.video.refsDrop: Drop Media tiles or files here to add them; drag a card onto another card of its lane to reorder.
studio.run.video.instructions: What to take from it (optional, for Prompt Forge)
studio.run.video.instructionsNeeded: Custom: say what to take from it (required)
studio.run.video.packInvalid: That file isn't a MiniMax H3 reference pack.
studio.run.video.trimInvalid: A trimmed clip must last 2–15 s (end after start).
studio.run.video.refFull: Director limit reached: 9 images, 3 videos, 3 audio clips, 12 files.
studio.run.video.refImagesOnly: LTX takes images as references only.
studio.run.video.ref2vaHint: MiniMax H3 runs these as REF2VA; pick a REF2VA checkpoint for best results.
studio.run.h3EditHint: MiniMax H3 edits the picture like the Director’s Image Inpaint mode: the prompt describes the change, the picture (or the masked crop) is the first frame of a short pass; denoise and the refine pass do not apply.
studio.run.cont.sessionHint: Checkpoints are stored on the backend under this session; a new session forgets the finished clips.
studio.run.cont.sessionNameHint: 1–80 ASCII letters, digits, _ or -. Apply keeps the steps/settings but clears their local clip links; backend clips are not deleted. Existing checkpoints are not loaded.
studio.run.cont.invalidSession: Enter 1–80 ASCII letters, digits, _ or -. The name _imports is reserved.
studio.run.cont.sourceHint: Read checkpoints from the active session explicitly, then pin a clip ID. Changing source resets only local step links, not backend files. A source starts the first step as a continuation.
studio.run.cont.noSources: No eligible checkpoints (at least 5 frames) in this session.
studio.run.cont.sourceFailed: Could not read checkpoints. Check the central Logs and retry explicitly.
studio.run.cont.sourceEndpointChanged: Backend changed. Clear the selected source, then load/prepare and select it again before running.
studio.run.cont.uploadVideoHint: Choose an MP4/MOV/WebM/MKV video (up to 512 MiB). Upload only fills the filename; then choose Prepare and Use video separately. Your original is unchanged. Closing ignores late replies but may not stop an upload already started.
studio.run.cont.uploadVideoFailed: Video upload failed. Check Logs, then retry explicitly.
studio.run.cont.videoHint: Enter the exact relative filename already in this backend’s input folder. Prepare hashes/probes and caches a source manifest, without VAE encoding or upload. Use video explicitly selects it; encoding happens at Run. Closing ignores late results but may not stop backend preparation.
studio.run.cont.videoFailed: Video preparation failed. Check central Logs; no source was changed.
studio.run.cont.videoSilent: No source audio; the backend encodes silence at Run
studio.run.cont.overlapHint: Hidden context from the previous clip for later steps, at 24 fps; default 22 frames. The backend may shorten it for a short source or the model window. The first take is unchanged.
studio.run.cont.actionHint: What happens next; empty continues naturally.
studio.run.cont.hint: Without a selected source, the first take is captured as a checkpoint. With a source, the first step extends it; later steps extend their generated predecessor.
studio.run.cont.stale: The plan changed while a step was starting; run it again.
studio.run.cont.noClip: The backend listed no new checkpoint for this step.
studio.run.opt.chunking.hint: Splits feed-forward activations to lower peak VRAM; the chunk count follows frames × canvas like the DaSiWa workflows. Pick your card's memory.
studio.run.opt.output.hint: Video encoding (DaSiWa Enhanced Video Combine): Auto prefers browser-friendly AV1/WebM, then VP9 and H.264. Image format and 0–100 compression apply to the DaSiWa image saver (0 = best quality).
studio.plan.notice: Live, read-only preview of the next Run. Edit settings in Generate. This is not a workflow editor or runtime progress.
studio.plan.validation: Native preparation revalidates this draft at Run; this preview does not prove model compatibility or generation readiness.
studio.plan.wildcardPending: Wildcard text resolves in the backend at Run; the base prompts and active rules are shown here.
studio.plan.audioPending: Audio is generated/conditioned by this family. Its effective sample rate and encoded stream are not yet resolved.
studio.plan.outputPending: Auto formats, final filenames, backend saver defaults and transferred files resolve at Run; this is not an export or overwrite confirmation.
studio.plan.mask: Mask upload pending; blur {blur} px, crop margin {grow} px, masked-area crop: {crop}. Crop geometry is captured at Run.
studio.plan.layersPending: Painted layers flatten and upload at Run; shown names/geometry are the current draft.
studio.plan.uploadPending: Selected external media uploads at Run; displayed source paths are not uploaded handles.
studio.plan.intent: Exact draft intent (upload handles and native defaults pending)
studio.plan.checkpointParts: From checkpoint; internal selection not inspected
studio.plan.imageOnly: Image-only refinement/wildcards/custom schedules are not applied by this video Run; H3 image edits also omit refinement.
studio.plan.nativePass: Native recipe resolves internal resize / pass defaults at Run
studio.run.prompt.prefillKinds: Prefill: read the RefMod library first (References tab), so each RefMod's media kinds are known.
studio.backend.unavailable: Backend not reachable. Start it under Backend. If it is already started, wait until it is ready, check the backend address and look in Logs.
studio.backend.timeout: The backend did not respond in time. It may still be starting or busy. Wait briefly and try again; check Backend and Logs if this continues.
studio.backend.requestFailed: The backend connection failed or was interrupted. Check its status and address under Backend, then try again. Details are in Logs.
studio.backend.httpError: The backend replied with HTTP {status}. Check Backend and Logs; verify the address and access settings, then try again.
